title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
source: flac24/96 Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > Dat (16-bit/44.1k) > upsampled to 24-bit/96k; Mastering Info:WAV > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; Master Reel Transferred by Rob Eaton; All Mastering By Charlie Miller; the original version of this source had a 2 second dropout in thrack 16 (Playing In The Band)

ai_review.summary: Excellent 1973 soundboard recording featuring a sweet Nobody's Fault But Mine jam, stellar Stella Blue and He's Gone performances.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as a high‑water mark of early‑'73 Dead, with reviewers calling out the soaring jam after Truckin', the glowing renditions of Stella Blue, He's Gone and Nobody’s Fault But Mine, plus a memorable Mississippi Half‑Step/Jack Straw flow. The soundboard source is described as crystal‑clear and “fantastic,” making the listening experience as vivid as being in the venue.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five detailed reviews give 5 stars, praising both performance and soundboard quality; one solid 4‑star review adds nuance but no criticism. Consistent high praise yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note the recording is crystal‑clear, well‑balanced and free of noticeable dropouts or muddiness. No technical flaws are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its natural flow – a sweet Mississippi‑Half Step ride into Jack Straw, a glorious Stella Blue, and an extended Nobody’s Fault But Mine jam after Truckin' that keeps the momentum high.
